title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: X is a smooth analytic manifold or orbifold ('multiplicité'), in the intended application presumably the compactified moduli multiplicity of M_{g,ν}. D ⊂ X is a divisor with normal crossings, the boundary at infinity. At a point x, let I(x) be the finite set of local branches D_α of D through x. Let Δ_x be the poset of germs at x of the boundary strata ('sous-multiplicités attachées à D'). Each such germ is the intersection of a subset of branches, so Δ_x ≅ P(I(x))^op, with the codimension function c(V) = number of branches.

Construction of D_d. For each d ≥ 0, D_d is the analytic multiplicity of pairs (x, V), where V is a codim-d germ of stratum at x. This is the normalization of the closed codim-d stratum. The canonical map D_d → X factors through D for d ≥ 1. It is a local immersion of codimension d. The margin adds that D_0 = X and D_0 → X is the identity.

The cover D̃_d. On D_d there is a d-sheeted étale cover D̃_d. Its fibre over (x, V) is the set of the d branches D_α at x that contain V. Its points are triples (x, V, W) with V ⊂ W germs of strata of codim d and 1. There is a canonical map D̃_d → D_1, (x, V, W) ↦ W.

Generalization to posets. Let J be a finite poset with a strictly monotone codim function (as in (151)). D_J is the multiplicity, of codim d = d(J), whose points are pairs (x, φ). Here φ: J ↪ Δ_x ≅ P(I(x))^op (eq. (152)) is an order-embedding compatible with the codim functions. Special cases:
- J a single point of codim d gives D_d.
- J = {d > 1} gives D̃_d.
- J the full chain d > d−1 > … > 0 gives the S_d-torsor of orderings of the branches (next page: D'_d, a torsor under G_d).

The next page states that D_J is smooth and D_J → X is a local immersion of codim d. D_J is reconstructed from D_d and its S_d-torsor, with a marginal caveat about when D'_d = D_{I(d)}.

Purpose. This is the combinatorial and geometric bookkeeping of the 'structure at infinity': stratum normalizations and branch local systems indexed by posets of strata. It presumably serves to describe the tubular neighbourhoods and fundamental groupoids at infinity of M_{g,ν}.
errors: No mathematical errors. Minor point: 'qui se factorise par D' is valid only for d ≥ 1; the margin handles d = 0 separately (D_0 = X).
The identification D'_d = D_{I(d)} needs the orbifold/automorphism caveat that Grothendieck himself flags in the margin of the next page.

ideas.what: Normalization D_d of codim-d strata of a normal crossings divisor, with local immersion D_d → X
ideas.modern_name: normalization of strata D^{(d)} / disjoint union of d-fold intersections of branches
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard; Deligne, Théorie de Hodge II (1971)
ideas.where_published: SGA 7 / SGA 1 XIII tame ramification contexts use similar notions

ideas.what: d-sheeted étale cover of branches over D_d, and the associated S_d-torsor of orderings
ideas.modern_name: local system of branches; orientation torsor (cf. Deligne's ε^d)

ideas.what: Poset-indexed strata spaces D_J for posets J with codim function embedding into P(I(x))^op
ideas.modern_name: spaces of flags of strata / nerve of the stratification poset; exit-path-type resolution of a normal crossings stratification

deep.surprise_reason: This is standard bookkeeping for normal crossings divisors: stratum normalizations, branch covers and orderings torsors. The poset-indexed D_J is a mild systematization, close to known nerve or exit-path constructions, with nothing new.
transcription_corrections: 'de valeur [?] p. Pour D_d, ... un revêtement étale : [...] feuilleté' should read approximately 'de codim d. On a sur D_d un revêtement étale à d feuillets, noté D̃_d'.
'en un pt (x,V) ... formé des [...] des branches' should read approximately 'dont la fibre en un pt (x,V) se forme des d branches D_α de D en x qui contiennent V'.
'fonctions coordonnées' should read 'fonctions codim' (codimension functions) throughout, including the margin: 'ou système de fonction codim strictement décr. cf (151)'.
'Δ_x ≃ Fl(I(x))^0' is likely 'Δ_x ≃ P(I(x))^o' (opposite of the power set of branches), matching 'D(I(x))°' on the previous page.
'si J est un ens. fini d'indices' should read approximately 'si J est un ens. ordonné muni d'une fonction codim, comme ci-dessus'.
